about.title: About EncodeX
about.subtitle: A free and open-source multimedia toolkit built on FFmpeg. Convert, inspect, compress, extract, cut, and batch-process audio, video, and images — all in one place.
about.description: EncodeX is a cross-platform multimedia toolkit that brings the power of FFmpeg to a modern, intuitive desktop interface. Convert audio, video, and images between formats with granular control over codecs, bitrate, resolution, pixel format, and quality; stream-copy tracks losslessly for instant remuxing; extract audio from video; and cut video with a frame-accurate preview player. Hardware-accelerated encoding is supported across NVIDIA NVENC, Intel QSV, AMD AMF, VAAPI, Apple VideoToolbox, and Microsoft Media Foundation, with available encoder families auto-detected from the bundled FFmpeg binary at runtime. Batch jobs run through a persistent queue with real-time progress, and a headless CLI mode exposes the same capabilities for scripting and automation.
